payload.title: Add sharing primitives: Invitation, Grant, ACL (FR-1)
payload.description:
Add cross-user sharing to Frick. Currently Frick's authz model is ownership-only and policy hooks can only tighten — there's no mechanism for user A to grant user B access to a record. RangerCRM needs this to replace its CloudKit sharing (see ~/dev/RangerCRM/docs/cloudkit-sharing-migration-design.md, options A/B/C).

Chosen design: Option C-on-A from that doc — invitation tokens + persistent per-record grants. Token = one-shot sender→recipient invite. Grant = durable {recordId, recipientUserId, permission: "read"|"write"}. Receiver-side queries return records where ownerId == me OR me has a matching Grant.

This is the upstream blocker for RCRM-78/79/80/81. Once shipped here, RangerCRM iOS work can land.
